evidence_note: Paths identify implementation and acceptance harnesses; actual results are recorded in VERIFICATION_0_9.md. A normal Metal job completed in 82.430497 seconds and passed 18 independent checks. Managed ComfyUI setup/start and one 192x128, nine-frame, four-step Wan take completed; independent media and native playback each passed 14 checks, matching all nine source frames. This does not establish production quality or default-size/long-session generation. The default attempt was cancelled on ordinary app termination, cause unknown. Native second-MOV-stream audio remains unaccepted after an intermittently silent fresh capture. The frozen current-source Python suite passed 515 tests in 153.974 seconds with zero failures and zero skips, including genuine RAW and official OTIO integration; this does not override the separate native audio failure. An installed 0.9 candidate exists, but three of its 53 runtime files differ from current audio JavaScript; the original production checkout has no Studio, the draft PR remains at 0.8, and 0.9 is unpublished. Core editor/server use the Python standard library; imaging/roto and managed generation use separate runtimes. Capability statuses remain conservative and do not imply full parity.

capabilities.scope: Reduced rational rates 1–60; exact media timestamps and absolute 48 kHz sample grid.

Own multitrack edit/trim/split/ripple/slip/slide/roll, constant speed/reverse, track controls, shared-format live sequences, manual multicam, captions and verified preview proxies. Variable speed ramps, optical-flow retiming, automatic multicamera sync and general offline/online conform remain missing.

Bounded cut/gap AV and nested Stack/Track exchange with source ranges, shared rational clock and explicit/trailing/all-gap duration. SHA-bound private authoring restores active/inactive sequences and all dependent media only when regenerated public timing/structure agrees. No transitions, OTIO retime/reverse, same-track overlaps, trimmed Tracks/top-level Stack, disabled nested items, general AAF/XML/native-project semantics.

One primary clip source plus eight independent project video/image sources in a 32-node graph; signed offsets, ranges, transparent/hold endpoints and ordered merges. Grade/curves/blur/sharpen/key/lens nodes have optional invertible alpha effect-mask inputs. Bounded graph JSON exchange uses current-project media IDs. No nested/deep/plugin graph.

Independent channels with linear, hold, ease-in/out, ease-in-out and monotone cubic progress tangents (0–3). Up to 128 scalar or 64 path keys per channel; 1,024 keys/8,192 animated values per graph. Bézier split/remove updates all path keys; arbitrary overshooting time curves remain unsupported.

Own cubic anchor/incoming/outgoing-handle and point-feather editing; 2–32 anchors, 64 path keys, global inward feather and per-point scale 0–4. Actual NumPy tiled 16-bit coverage, 2×2 sampling and 0.125-output-pixel flattening feed paused/export graph. One closed supported SVG path import/export with owned feather metadata; no general SVG document, roto-layer hierarchy or paint. Worker output limited to 4 GiB.
No deep, multiview, arbitrary-channel EXR graph.
Actual FFmpeg correlation; 384-pixel analysis edge, 480 frames and explicit missing matches.
Independent additive translation with up to 128 simplified keys; no automatic crop.
New ellipse with animated measured center, preserving authored channels. Not segmentation.
No affine/projective solve, re-identification or lens/rolling-shutter estimation.
Display-referred Rec.709 timeline grades, RGB curves and scopes measured from actual rendered display RGB. Optional OCIO still-image development remains separate from this SDR movie graph.

Separate OCIO/RAW/bracket still processing and authored Cycles frame sequences preserve scene-linear float EXR masters. Cycles supports premultiplied RGBA beauty and depth/normal/vector/diffuse/emission passes. Movie compositing/delivery remains SDR; no whole-timeline OCIO/ACES management, HDR mastering or calibrated output monitoring.
Bounded cubic roto path editing and one-path SVG boundary exchange exist. Full vector document/layer/gradient/operator model, general SVG/Lottie interchange and text animators remain missing.

Own WebGL primitive/mesh controls, object parenting and inherited local pose keys, bounded vertex/face/UV edits and eight live modifier types, materials/camera/lights, actual headless Cycles and retained .blend. Not unrestricted Blender authoring.
Indexed OBJ/selected MTL import with UVs, normals and material partitions; actual viewport and retained Blender geometry.

Bounded vertex move/face extrude/delete/subdivide, editable UVs, object hierarchy and actual Mirror/Bevel/Subdivision/Solidify/Array/Decimate/Smooth/Simple Deform stacks. Edge tools, texture painting/shader graphs, camera/light parenting, constraints, rigs, shape keys, sculpting, geometry nodes and simulation remain missing.
Bounded PINHOLE/SIMPLE_PINHOLE solved-camera import with exact pose/intrinsics; no feature extraction, SfM, bundle adjustment or dense reconstruction.
Source architecture reviewed; no solver/graph worker or photogrammetry acceptance.
Predictor source reviewed; no actual segmentation worker/checkpoint execution.
Coordinates/state source reviewed; no actual learned tracking worker.
Camera/ray/pose source reviewed; no inference or general faithful camera-conditioning export.

Configured API workflow/preflight, scoped prompts and verified output admission; actual pinned ComfyUI 0.42.1 install verified 10,634,173,896 bytes across source, 71 wheels and three models, then owned MPS startup passed 11 core nodes. Wan 1.3B produced 192x128, nine H.264 frames at 16 fps, four steps, seed 42 in 44.410 seconds; 14 independent and 14 native checks passed in 1.393 seconds, including all nine actual source pictures. Remaining validation applies to the default 480x272/17-frame/20-step workflow, quality, longer takes and sustained operation; that default attempt was cancelled about 21 seconds into ordinary app termination, cause unknown. One small core text-to-video proof does not implement general ComfyUI/model-authoring or commercial-provider parity.

Decoded waveforms, track/clip gain, balance, fades, constant retime/reverse and stereo export. Explicit source stream and any valid pair of source channels map to L/R; mapped waveforms/export use those channels. Native live audio remains unaccepted: an earlier 32,768-sample capture passed, but the latest second-MOV-stream capture was silent; the defect and gain/pan/restart acceptance remain unresolved. Reverse interactive audio is muted. No full DAW, buses/plugins or general output layouts.
Typed recipes, snapshot jobs, owned-process cancellation, receipts and polling recovery. No arbitrary scripting, expression or plugin host.
H.264 MP4 and ProRes MOV with actual render snapshot/source identity. Separate imaging jobs retain float EXR and display PNG. No universal broadcast/cinema/HDR delivery suite.
No full decoded/GPU realtime cache, collaborative database or signed/notarized bundled runtime.
No authenticated Runway/Krea/OpenArt/Magnific/Artlist/Firefly/Flow/Luma/Kling/Pika/FLORA/Weave integration.
Explicit Rec.709/sRGB/linear/LogC3 EI800 decode, Rec.709/Rec.2020/ACEScg/AWG3 primaries and Bradford white adaptation in float RGBA; Rec.709 SDR output.

Project-owned SHA-256 Cube 1D/3D tables and combined 1D-shaper + 3D files. Single-table per-channel domains; combined stage-specific scalar input ranges. Linear shaper precedes selected nearest/trilinear/tetrahedral 3D stage in actual FFmpeg processing. 65,536 1D rows, 65-cube 3D size, 24 MiB per file; ambiguous shared combined domains reject.
Data-only fSpy v1/JSON import; preserved calibrated roll, principal offsets and focal scales; explicit world axis/scale and one undoable camera replacement.
Own WebGL and retained Blender camera share vertical FOV, roll, off-axis principal offsets and fx/fy; project/source aspect must agree.
Sensor height/focal length, focus distance, f-stop and aperture shape; bounded physical channels and actual Cycles DOF. No lens prescription design.
Principled transmission, IOR and scene-linear emission, with base color/roughness/metallic. Bounded material controls; no full shader graph.
Actual Cycles max/diffuse/glossy/transmission/transparent bounce counts, denoising and seed in saved scene; no Mitsuba/pbrt renderer or inverse solver.
Validated Brown forward and bounded numerical inverse functions; the separate calibrated-lens node now applies a stricter five-term model to actual footage pixels. No Lensfun profile conversion.
No Optiland/ray-optics optical prescription, sequential/nonsequential trace, glass catalogue, optimization, aberration/PSF/MTF toolchain.
No Mitsuba spectral/polarized/differentiable backend, inverse optimization or pbrt scene transport.
No general lazy scene graph, path/set/context model, asset variations or distributed Gaffer-style dispatch.

Actual rawpy/LibRaw unpack and demosaic for preserved SHA-addressed camera RAW stills; white balance, highlight and half-size controls, float linear EXR and separate OCIO display image. No RAW movie timeline.

Known-response radiance merge of 2–16 aligned static-scene stills with explicit shutter times; float EXR and separate display output. No alignment, ghost removal, response-curve fitting, panorama stitching or colour-hdri runtime.
No DiffusionLight checkpoint/inference/HDR environment generation; reading source is not model integration.

One native application with CINEMATICUM authoring controls and owned local service; verified archive/rollback during replacement. A 0.9 candidate is installed, but three of its 53 runtime files differ from current audio JavaScript under review. Original production checkout has no Studio, draft PR remains at 0.8, and no 0.9 publication is recorded. FFmpeg/Blender and optional imaging/generation runtimes are separate installed dependencies; no signed/notarized self-contained distribution.
Own Trim dialog previews and applies integer-frame source slip, touching-shot slide and outgoing-cut roll with speed/reverse/source-handle limits, locked-track rejection and one shared undo.

Up to eight independent owned project-media nodes with source in, duration, signed animation offset and transparent/hold endpoints. Preserved trim/split domain, paused/export parity and no implicit source audio mix.

Static five-term Brown footage undistort/redistort with normalized intrinsics, compatible scene-camera copy, premultiplied bilinear RGBA and transparent borders. Whole-image contraction bound q≤0.45; at most two nodes; nonidentity canvas ≤2,073,600 pixels. No fisheye, lens database or automatic calibration.

Own vertex/face selection and move, face extrusion, connected subdivision and face deletion. Authored cage hashes separate original import provenance; 10,000 vertices/faces, 60,000 corners, 512 selected elements, one undo per evaluated edit. Vertex moves retain UV seams; topology-changing edits invalidate UVs and require reprojection.

Up to eight ordered actual Blender Mirror/Bevel/Subdivision/Solidify/Array/Decimate/Smooth/Simple Deform modifiers; parameters, enable/reorder/remove/refresh/apply. Array 1–64, subdivision 1–3, expansion/geometry budgets validated. Actual evaluated viewport geometry and retained live .blend cage/stack independently rechecked before rendering.

Actual OpenColorIO builtin-config CPU source-to-scene-linear and display/view transforms with explicit input space and exposure. ACES-capable builtin configs; current display output fixed to sRGB. No arbitrary external config or movie-wide color management.

Single-part RGB/RGBA still input and float32 ZIP EXR output retain negative/superwhite values and explicit premultiplied alpha; output receipt binds config, runtime, source and artifact identity. Separate display PNG enters SDR editing. No deep/multipart/arbitrary-channel movie graph.

Owned polling identity rejects late responses for earlier jobs; interrupted polling exposes Retry status and Cancel. Mesh candidates require current project/revision/object identity before one undoable apply. Recovery does not silently apply abandoned candidates.

Core standard-library server invokes a separate isolated worker. Stable Mac interpreter at ~/Library/Application Support/CINEMATICUM/Imaging/py313-v1/bin/python; NumPy 2.3.5, OpenColorIO 2.6.0, rawpy 0.27.1 and OpenEXR 3.4.15. Runtime and actual engine outputs are checked separately.

Revision-bound per-editor checkpoints, monotonic acknowledgements, explicit recovery with one undo entry and up to 20 previous saves. Current media inventory remains authoritative; failed/corrupt checkpoints are not silently treated as saved.

Streamed ZIP64 export and verified fresh-identity restore of owned edit/media/LUT/workflow/RAW/imaging/scene dependencies; 64 GiB and 10,000 member bounds. No automatic workflow execution or external model/plugin bundling.

Select a shot-list document, review requirements, bind actual video and source ranges, preview takes, persist unresolved plans, assemble exact-frame continuous cuts as one undoable edit, and download shot requirements. Missing/short/off-grid sources prevent assembly; no filler or issuance.

Actual Cycles float32 scene-linear Rec.709 RGBA EXR sequences, premultiplied transparent world and selectable depth/normal/vector/diffuse/emission passes; lossless ZIP and per-file/hash/clock manifest. H.264 review remains display-referred.

Continuous transported aiming for new/imported cameras; legacy world-up framing preserved until explicit change. Complete eased intervals reject undefined camera/target and aimed-light collisions before engine launch. Vertex edits retain UV seams.

All eight EXIF display orientations share bounded FFprobe admission and exactly-once decoding. Deleted/rebound clips release media listeners and audio graph nodes; inactive playback resources are bounded while active layers are preserved.

64 sequences share project canvas, exact rate and media. Active/inactive editing, duplicate/rename/switch/delete, live nested picture/sound with per-instance trims and transforms. Eight nesting levels, 256 clips/128 plates per sequence, 4,096 stored clips and 1,024 expanded instances including nested nodes/text; cycles and referenced-sequence deletion reject.

Manual common-event source-frame sync for 2–16 distinct videos per group, up to 64 groups, cut-at-playhead angle changes with camera-following audio. Group duration ends at shortest remaining angle. Switch before clip retime/tracking/compositing; no automatic waveform/timecode sync, simultaneous angle monitor or audio-lock mode.

Plain Unicode SRT/WebVTT import/edit/export with absolute endpoints rounded once to exact project frames; optional rendered text-plate burn-in. 4,096 cues, 4,000 chars/cue, 2 MiB import; burn-in shares 128-title budget. Styled/timed markup, WebVTT regions/styles/position settings are rejected.
Selectable NDF/DF labels; drop-frame numbering only at exact 30000/1001 and 60000/1001. Changes displayed frame labels, not picture clock or audio placement.

Owned H.264/AAC preview derivatives at long edges 640/960/1280/1920 without upscale; verified decoded picture count and relative timestamps within 2 microseconds, SHA-bound receipt and 1,300,000-frame analysis bound. Native preview switches actual decoder URL; original-based export is unchanged. Cancellable owned job; no general offline/online conform or decoded GPU cache.

Selected original bytes restore an admitted asset only after recorded SHA-256 and size match. Existing identity/edits retained; damaged original backed up, wrong content rejected. Native acceptance tests missing-source repair and independently decoded original exports. Different takes must be imported as new assets.

Object-only acyclic parent links, at most 24 total levels, exact affine inheritance including nonuniform scale and local pose keys in viewport and real .blend. Reparenting keeps local values; world moves convert through parent inverse. Parent with children cannot be deleted. No camera/light parenting, constraints or automatic keep-world transform.

Own box/planar/per-face projection, actual Blender smart unwrap, selected-face seam separation, connected-island grid packing and UV point drag/numeric/rotate/mirror/scale. 512 selected UVs; quad/n-gon corners and seams survive real Blender replay. Grid packing preserves individual aspect but does not optimize packing/texel density; no texture paint or image shader authoring.

CPU (default), Metal, CUDA, OptiX, HIP and oneAPI selection; actual executing Blender must enumerate a matching available device or fail without silent CPU fallback. Receipt records requested/actual devices; .blend stores GPU flag/recipe, not portable machine preferences. After an earlier short harness timeout, a normal owned Metal job rendered one 192x128 frame at four samples without denoising in 82.430497 seconds; independent verification passed 18/18 checks in 6.694 seconds on decoded pixels, retained scene and device receipt. Other GPU backends and production-scale throughput remain unverified.
